listing.name: Dead Space 2 (Xbox 360) — Dead Space 2 Recomp (bifftannen1)
listing.summary: Campaign/Severed not fully playtested; online features untested. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Dead Space 2 (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. World En/Fr/Es Disc 1 title 454108DF/media 2915C8F8; Disc 2 media 403243EC optional; mandatory TU 2 to 0.0.2.3; own Severed optional.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the project’s TU 2 playtest Windows package and DS2Launcher to check your own Disc 1 and TU 2. Your own Disc 2 and Severed are optional.

warnings: Campaign/Severed not fully playtested; online features untested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
